top_signal.title: If you're a small business looking for a data analyst but don't have the budget to hire one, this one for u.
top_signal.summary: Data is the fuel of growth.    As a startup, you probably don't have much data of your own, or maybe you only have a small amount, so you think data analytics is a very later step. But there's a huge amount of data out there, you can benefit from, and im not only talking about ready-to-use online datasets but also the data that we can scrape from different platforms. You can use it to gain valuable insights and level up your business.   and I wanna help u with this, at no cost    Why am I doing this?    It's been 15 months since I started working in the analytics field. I've worked closely with businesses and learned a lot from them. Now I work part-time and have quite a bit of free time, which I initially intended to dedicate to learning.   I searched a lot for good case studies to work on, but most of them are quite simple. And I thought: Why not work on real cases, real-life projects, and real challenges instead of mock ones, while simultaneously helping some businesses grow?   so reach out to me with more details about your business.        submitted by     /u/Much-Corner-4803       [link]       [comments]
